## **Introduction**

In this 5-day course, you will learn the basics of **software engineering** by building a small web application from start to finish.

## **⚠️ Before You Start**

1. ### **Sign up for [Kiro](https://kiro.dev/)** *(and make sure you remember your **Builder ID** as you need it to submit it on the project submission form later)*

**Kiro** is the **main tool** you will use to help you:

* Understand the task  
* Break features into smaller steps  
* Get help with code and debugging

> 

2. ### **Other Tools Needed**

Make sure you also have:

* GitHub Desktop  
* A GitHub account

---

## **⚠️ Required Features (MVP)**

Your project **must include**:

* ### **Input Form**

  * Fields: **Item Name**, **Amount**, **Category** (Food, Transport, Fun)  
  * Add a transaction to the list when submitted  
  * Validate that all fields are filled

* **Transaction List**  
  * Scrollable list of all added items  
  * Show name, amount, and category  
  * Ability to delete items  
* **Total Balance**  
  * Display total balance at the top  
  * Updates automatically when items are added or deleted  
* **Visual Chart**  
  * Pie chart showing spending distribution by category  
  * Chart updates automatically when items change  
  * You can use **Chart.js** or another simple chart library

## ---

## **Project Overview**

You will build an **Expense & Budget Visualizer.** This is a mobile-friendly web app that helps users track their daily spending. It shows their total balance, a history of transactions, and a visual chart of spending by category. You can build it as a simple web page that works well on phones.

## 

## **Constraint** (*Please copy this on Kiro*)**:**

## **Technical Constraints**

### **TC-1: Technology Stack**

* HTML for structure  
* CSS for styling  
* Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks like React, Vue, etc.)  
* No backend server required

### **TC-2: Data Storage**

* Use browser Local Storage API  
* All data stored client-side only

### **TC-3: Browser Compatibility**

* Must work in modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)  
* Can be used as standalone web app or browser extension

## **Non-Functional Requirements**

### **NFR-1: Simplicity**

* Clean, minimal interface  
* Easy to understand and use  
* No complex setup required  
* No test setup required

### **NFR-2: Performance**

* Fast load time  
* Responsive UI interactions  
* No noticeable lag when updating data

### **NFR-3: Visual Design**

* User-friendly aesthetic  
* Clear visual hierarchy  
* Readable typography

## ---

## **⚠️ Folder Rules**

* Only **1 CSS file** inside css/  
* Only **1 JavaScript file** inside js/  
* Keep code clean and readable

## ---

## **⚠️ GitHub & Deployment** (*Only basic Git is needed*)

* Use GitHub Desktop to save your work  
* Push your code to GitHub  
* Publish the site using GitHub Pages

## **⚠️ Optional Challenges** *(Choose 3\)*

**Choose 3** out of these 5 options to make your project more interactive and user-friendly:

- [ ] Allow users to add custom categories  
- [ ] Add a monthly summary view  
- [ ] Sort transactions by amount or category  
- [ ] Highlight spending over a set limit  
- [ ] Dark/light mode toggle
